article.title: Ayribobo
article.extract: Ayribobo or Aýrybaba, officially named the Great Saparmyrat Turkmenbashi Peak in Turkmenistan since 2004, is a mountain in Central Asia. At 3,138 metres (10,295 ft) Aýrybaba is the highest mountain in Turkmenistan. It is located in the Köýtendag Range of the Pamir-Alay chain in the southeast of Turkmenistan on the Uzbekistani border.
